import numpy as np
np.set_printoptions(precision=3, suppress=True)
E = W["embed.W_E"]
P = W["pos_embed.W_pos"]
A = W["blocks.0.mlp.W_in"]
B = W["blocks.0.mlp.W_out"]
te = E @ A
pe = P @ A
ts = np.std(te[2:], axis=0)
ps = np.std(pe[1:], axis=0)
strength = np.linalg.norm(B, axis=1)
idx = np.argsort(strength * np.sqrt(ts**2 + ps**2))[-20:][::-1]
print("Overall token/position variation:", np.linalg.norm(ts), np.linalg.norm(ps))
for j in idx:
    print("neuron", j, "outnorm", round(float(strength[j]),3),
          "token", te[2:,j], "position", pe[1:,j],
          "bias", round(float(W["blocks.0.mlp.b_in"][j]),3))
